name: History, persistence, and deletion
userOutcome: A user can reopen saved fits, see their images, favorite or delete them, and remove all local fit data with explicit confirmation.
productionDataSource: SwiftData FitSession records and media files in AuraFit's private Documents directory.
errorBehavior: Persistent-container fallback is disclosed. Save failures prevent navigation to a falsely durable result. Deletion removes the record and all referenced local assets; orphan reconciliation removes only old unreferenced managed files.
accessibilityRequirements: Fit cards expose score, date, favorite status, and navigation role
Empty and storage-fallback states are readable with VoiceOver
prohibitedBehavior: Do not silently fall back to temporary storage
Do not delete files outside AuraFit's managed media folders
Do not use preview sessions in production history
acceptanceTests: ModelTests SwiftData insert, repository create/delete, and seed idempotence tests
ImageFileStoreTests including thumbnail caching and orphan reconciliation
Physical-device relaunch, favorite, single-delete, delete-all, and image-render checks
